info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to information regarding the expiration status of hotel loyalty points for customers. It enables businesses to track and manage loyalty rewards, ensuring customers are aware of their point balance and expiration dates. Typical users include hotel management systems, customer service platforms, and loyalty program applications seeking to enhance user engagement through timely notifications. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve customer retention and satisfaction by keeping their guests informed about their loyalty rewards.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the expiration details for user points, ensuring you can manage and utilize your points effectively before they expire.
